shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && find . -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' | head -50

for f in index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && cat ThemeProvider.js ThemeContext.d.ts useTheme.js useThemeType.js constants.js types.d.ts; grep -n "Segmented\|RadioButton\|Switch" ../index.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/index.d.ts; ls node_modules | grep -i "jsdom\|happy-dom"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm 2>/dev/null | grep -i "sun\|moon\|monitor" | head
rm -rf dist && (which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i "playwright\|puppeteer"; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null) ; echo "---"; git status --short
